title: Penguins Forward Andrei Kuzmenko Takes Leave After Father Killed in Bear Attack in Siberia
dek: Pittsburgh Penguins forward Andrei Kuzmenko took a leave of absence after his father, Alexander Kuzmenko, 62, was killed in a bear attack in Siberia on Tuesday and died Wednesday. The incident occurred during a fishing trip in a remote, forested area near the Krasnaya River in Tuva.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Andrei Kuzmenko's father, Alexander, a well-known Russian hockey coach, was attacked by a bear on a fishing trip in Siberia and died from severe facial injuries after a four-hour delay in emergency medical response.
bottom_line: The duration of Kuzmenko's leave remains unconfirmed; the team has not announced a timeline for his return to the roster.
body:
Pittsburgh Penguins forward Andrei Kuzmenko, 30, took a leave of absence after his father, Alexander Kuzmenko, 62, was killed in a bear attack during a fishing trip in Siberia. Alexander died Wednesday, one day after the attack.
Alexander Kuzmenko was a well-known hockey coach in Russia. According to The Guardian, he was on a fishing trip in Tuva, a landlocked region in Siberia near Russia's southern border with Mongolia, when his group encountered a bear. The forested area along the Krasnaya River where the group was located had previously been restricted due to bear activity, per The Guardian.
Emergency response was severely delayed. The group had to travel down the river for four hours before an ambulance could locate them. Alexander Kuzmenko sustained severe facial injuries and was airlifted to a hospital, where he was pronounced dead on Wednesday.
Andrei Kuzmenko had signed a one-year contract with the Penguins in July and was in training camp when the attack occurred. According to The Guardian, he attended practice with the team on the morning of his father's death before departing for Moscow to be with his family.

Andrei Kuzmenko made his NHL debut in 2022 with the Vancouver Canucks after breaking out with CSKA Moscow and SKA Saint Petersburg in the Kontinental Hockey League. He had stints with the Calgary Flames, Philadelphia Flyers, and Los Angeles Kings before joining Pittsburgh. According to The Guardian, he has 85 goals and 97 assists in 271 NHL appearances. When Kuzmenko left Vancouver in 2023, his father, mother Galina, sister Victoria, and a childhood friend wrote a letter to the Canucks fanbase thanking them for their "warm hospitality towards our son" and "for helping him grow professionally."
According to The Guardian, at least 15 people have been killed in bear attacks across Russia this year.
